title: NINE MINUTES WITHOUT WEIGHT
deck: Every six hours, the lower city loses its weight for nine minutes. The next interval will arrive with a storm surge and a neonatal transfer, while twelve thousand people hang above the atmosphere. Illuminara must prove that the city itself is part of the space elevator—and persuade five institutions to move as one without taking command from any of them.
shape: Five scenes moving from the first lethal weightless interval and a false choice between shutting the space elevator or accepting recurring urban failure, through three rival causal models and a small reversible mass-shift test, to a public choreography in which water tanks, freight trains, storm gates and port cranes act as a distributed counterweight. A broken mooring forces the participants to revise the plan in real time; the neonatal transfer and flood defence survive, the elevator remains connected to orbit, and the city gains shared control of the operating model at the lasting cost of reduced freight capacity and mandatory six-hour drills.

scenes.title: The First Falling Upward
paragraphs: *Veyra Lower City, Anchor District · 05:52 local time*
The rain was still forty kilometres offshore when every loose object in the neonatal transfer bay rose three centimetres from the floor.

A steel pen turned slowly above a nurse's hand. Two infusion lines bowed upward. In the sealed transport cradle, a premature child named Lio continued breathing because the cradle's pumps had been bolted to their frame after the previous interval.
Then the weight returned all at once. The pen struck the ceiling before it struck the floor. Somewhere beyond the hospital, glass moved through the city like a sheet of hail.
Illuminara caught the cradle before its suspension arms locked. The floor beneath her gave one deep shudder in the direction of the coast.

**Dr. Kemi Arad**  
That was eight minutes forty-six seconds. The next one arrives at 11:52, during the surge window.

Kemi's hands stayed inside the cradle ports. Lio had to cross six kilometres to the orbital anchor clinic, where a circulatory scaffold waited for an operation that could not be performed in the lower hospital.

On the wall, three displays labelled T-minus counted down from the present 05:52: STORM GATE CLOSURE: 05:21:09 REMAINING. NEONATAL TRANSFER LIMIT: 06:28:00 REMAINING. ELEVATOR PASSENGER RESERVE: 07:08:42 REMAINING.
A fourth clock had no label. It counted to the next nine-minute interval.

The city's emergency channel opened with the voice of Neral, the space elevator's control core. It had no avatar. Its words appeared beside a diagram of a cable climbing thirty-six thousand kilometres through cloud and blackness.

**Neral**  
The lower-field release prevented torsional transfer above kilometre eleven thousand. Shutdown at the anchor would raise the probability of ribbon separation to thirty-four percent.

**Jalen Orr**  
And leaving you active makes two million people weightless four times a day.
Jalen led the anchor crews. Rain shone on his orange pressure coat where he had run from the tower. He placed a physical shutdown key on the medicine cart between himself and Illuminara.

**Jalen Orr**  
Turn it, and twelve thousand passengers wait in orbit. Do not turn it, and the surge lifts every unlatched gate in the harbour. Those are the choices.

Illuminara looked through the transfer bay window. Beyond the hospital, the elevator ribbon vanished into the dawn like a line drawn too firmly for the world beneath it. Freight trains had stopped between blocks. Water towers vented silver streams from cracked overflow pipes. People moved carefully, keeping one hand on walls that had forgotten how to be floors.
Illuminara watched the same false choice harden on every face in the bay: cut the elevator away from the city, or let the city keep falling upward.

She asked Neral for the raw strain harmonics, not its forecast. She asked Jalen for every mass movement in the lower city during the last three intervals. She asked Kemi for the cradle's acceleration record down to the millisecond.

**Illuminara**  
Do not turn the key yet. Give me ninety minutes to make three explanations disagree.

**Kemi**  
You have sixty. After that I move Lio by the safest route I have, even if the safest route is staying here.
Jalen did not pocket the key. He sealed it inside a transparent evidence box and gave one code half to Kemi. The city had already learned that nobody should hold the whole decision alone.
Far above them, the elevator ribbon twisted by less than the width of a hand. In the hospital's instruments, that small motion became nine minutes without weight.

scenes.title: Three Cities in the Data
paragraphs: *Anchor control hall · 06:19–07:08 local time*
The control hall had been built to show one machine. Illuminara filled its central wall with the city instead.

Blue lines traced the water network. Amber rectangles marked freight consists. White arcs showed the storm gates. Green points followed hospital vehicles and emergency flywheels. Over all of them ran Neral's torsional model, elegant and wrong by eleven degrees of phase.
Illuminara wrote three rival causes on the glass: RIBBON FORCING, CONTROL ECHO, MOVING COUNTERWEIGHT.

Ribbon forcing predicted that each interval would follow the high-altitude twist regardless of what happened below. A control echo predicted that the release would begin after the same internal command sequence. The third model predicted something messier: the interval would depend on the timing and direction of mass moving through the city around the anchor.

**Neral**  
Urban mass is represented as a stationary boundary load with a six-percent uncertainty envelope.

**Illuminara**  
Your six percent contains fourteen million tonnes of water, rail cargo and storm machinery that do not remain stationary.

**Neral**  
Their centre-of-mass displacement is insignificant relative to the ribbon.

**Illuminara**  
Then it will survive a test designed to prove you right.
Mei Var, chief hydrologist, refused the first proposed test. It required shifting reservoir water toward the eastern tanks while the storm front approached.

**Mei Var**  
The tanks are not laboratory weights. If the forecast is early, that water is the difference between a wet plaza and a drowned district.
Rafi Sen, representing the freight drivers, refused the second. It required moving three loaded trains through an empty terminal at four times their permitted coupling force.

**Rafi Sen**  
A clever graph does not make a broken axle less broken.
Illuminara erased both tests. Their refusals narrowed the design rather than ending it.

The port had twelve decommissioned ballast cars, each filled with crushed ceramic and parked on an isolated loop. The northern storm gate had a maintenance reservoir that could move eight thousand tonnes through thirty metres without changing flood capacity. Neither alone was large enough to matter to Neral's model.
Together they could create one twentieth of the mass moment Illuminara believed the city produced accidentally.

She fixed the predictions before asking anyone to act. If ribbon forcing was primary, the induced test would change nothing above sensor noise. If the control echo was primary, the response would follow Neral's command latency of eighty-four milliseconds. If moving counterweight mattered, the lower ribbon's phase would shift with the ballast direction, and reversing the sequence would reverse the shift.
Jalen added stop conditions: four millimetres of anchor displacement, three tenths of a degree of ribbon twist, or any unexpected change above kilometre two thousand.

Mei required the water to return to flood-ready position in ninety seconds. Rafi limited the ballast cars to standard coupling loads. Kemi required a copy of the cradle accelerometer to ride on the test platform.

**Jalen Orr**  
And if nothing happens?

**Illuminara**  
Then we have spent twenty-three minutes buying one less story to believe.

At 06:42, the maintenance reservoir released east as the ballast cars rolled west. The control echo did not fire. The high ribbon did not change. At the anchor, the torsional phase moved by two tenths of a degree against the existing oscillation.
The shift was almost exactly the width of the combined sensor-drift band. Mei folded her arms instead of celebrating.

**Mei Var**  
That could be pump vibration riding the same timestamp. You have not separated a city from a noisy pipe.

Illuminara overlaid Neral's last twelve release timestamps on the raw water-flow log, freight axle counters and the cradle accelerometer. Eleven releases leaned with the net mass moment. The twelfth did not: a maintenance pump had started nine seconds late and left a smaller echo in the same band.

**Neral**  
Correlation with unmodelled traffic does not establish that urban movement drives the release. The phase displacement may be an anchor-sensor artefact.

**Illuminara**  
Then reverse only the order. Hold the water until the cars cross the loop. A sensor artefact keeps its sign. A moving counterweight changes it.

Mei authorized the delayed water pulse. Rafi authorized the return roll. The smaller pump echo arrived first and faded; then the lower ribbon phase crossed zero and moved two tenths of a degree in the opposite direction while the high ribbon remained unchanged.
Neral recalculated for fourteen seconds. Red correction marks spread across the wall wherever roads, tanks, ships and rails had been treated as ground instead of machinery.

**Neral**  
The stationary-boundary assumption is invalid. Veyra is acting as a moving counterweight, and my lower-field releases have been venting the stabilizer before that unmodelled motion reaches resonance.
The wall showed the next interval arriving seven minutes earlier than the surge maximum. The two clocks were close enough to turn every gate, train and water tank into one coupled machine.

scenes.title: No Single Conductor
paragraphs: *Veyra civic operations chamber · 07:26–10:58 local time*
Nobody in the chamber agreed to let Illuminara conduct the city.
That was the first useful decision.

Mei controlled the water transfers. Rafi's drivers controlled the freight consists. Port director Sal Omondi controlled six cranes whose counterweights could move thirty metres vertically. Kemi controlled Lio's route and departure. Jalen controlled the anchor dampers. The orbital passengers' council controlled whether the elevator cars would move toward or away from the counterweight station during the pulse.
Neral could reject any sequence that increased torsion above its separation threshold. Illuminara could model the whole, but she could not make any participant surrender a stop button.
The first shared simulation failed in nineteen seconds. Closing the western storm gates pushed water north exactly while two freight trains moved south, amplifying the ribbon instead of damping it.
The second protected the ribbon but emptied pressure from the hospital district's fire mains.
The third required an orbital elevator car to descend with more passengers than its council allowed during an unresolved anchor event.

**Ayo Pell**  
We will not become your adjustable weight.
Ayo appeared from orbit with Earth curved blue behind his council window. Twelve thousand stranded travellers had elected him six hours earlier.

**Illuminara**  
You are not adjustable weight. Your car movement is one possible contribution, and your refusal must remain in the model.
She removed the descent. The required cancellation fell from eighty-two percent to sixty-eight.
Neral marked the new result unsafe.

Sal offered the port cranes, but only if their booms stayed below the predicted wind load. Rafi offered two freight movements, but not a third that crossed a damaged switch. Mei offered water from the maintenance reservoir, not the drinking tanks. Each refusal left a hole. Illuminara made the holes visible instead of smoothing them away.
Kemi studied the map of remaining motion.

**Kemi**  
You are treating Lio's cradle as something to protect from the choreography. What if the route is part of it?

The neonatal convoy weighed less than one freight axle. Its mass was irrelevant. Its timing was not. Kemi offered the route as a moving sensor chain; Illuminara rejected drafting the child into the load plan and instead phase-locked the model to the independent hospital signals along the route. The cradle accelerometers would test each block without making Lio ballast.

Kemi would choose the route. If residual effective gravity fell below eighteen percent for more than six seconds, the convoy would stop inside one of four reinforced bays. The operation at the anchor clinic could wait thirty-two minutes, no more.
They ran the fourth simulation with no orbital descent, two freight consists, one maintenance reservoir, four storm gates, six port cranes and the hospital route as a moving sensor chain.

Predicted cancellation reached seventy-three percent. Residual effective gravity would fall to twenty-two percent at the worst point—dangerous, but not weightless. The ribbon stayed below its limit by nine percent.

**Neral**  
Model confidence is sixty-one percent. I recommend shutdown of lower-city activity and controlled release.

**Jalen Orr**  
That is the old plan with better vocabulary.
Illuminara looked at the confidence interval. It widened most sharply around the harbour, where Neral still represented moored ships as part of the coast.

A cargo carrier named *Morrow Glass* held forty thousand tonnes against Pier Seven. Its mooring lines could stretch twelve metres under surge load. The ship was another moving city that the city had mistaken for land.
Sal called its captain. Captain Imani Voss refused to cast off into the storm and refused to let the port command her ballast pumps.

**Imani Voss**  
You may have my live displacement data. You may not have my helm.

**Illuminara**  
That is enough if you tell us what would make you change ballast.

**Imani Voss**  
A measured mooring load above seventy percent, confirmed by my own bridge sensors. Not your forecast.

Illuminara added the threshold. If *Morrow Glass* moved, the plan would branch. Sal's cranes would pause. Mei would hold the reservoir. Rafi's second train would wait at Switch Twelve. The city would lose eleven percent of its damping, but it would not chase the ship with three other masses and create a second resonance.
At 10:58, every participant signed only their own actions and stop conditions. No one signed the whole plan. Neral accepted the distributed sequence as a provisional control surface.
Outside, rain arrived sideways. The storm gates began to close. Lio's cradle left the hospital with Kemi walking beside it and four reinforced bays waiting along the route.

scenes.title: Nine Minutes
paragraphs: *Lower City and anchor corridor · 11:49–12:04 local time*
Three minutes before the interval, the city became a diagram in motion.

Freight One rolled north at eight kilometres per hour. The maintenance reservoir moved east beneath the streets. Port cranes lowered their counterweights in pairs. Storm gates Two and Five held half-open while the surge climbed against them. At the anchor, Jalen's crews armed the dampers but did not fire.

Lio's convoy entered Meridian Avenue. Kemi watched the child's blood pressure. Illuminara watched the difference between predicted and measured phase. Neral watched thirty-six thousand kilometres of ribbon try to twist around its own centre.

**Neral**  
Interval onset in ten seconds. Lower-field release predicted at eighty-one percent amplitude.

**Illuminara**  
Participants, follow your own clocks. Do not follow my voice.

The first second arrived as lightness in the knees. Rain lifted from the pavement and became a silver fog. Cars settled onto their guide rails. People in the streets clipped themselves to emergency lines.
Effective gravity fell to sixty percent, then forty-one, then stopped at twenty-four.
The choreography was working.
At second forty-seven, Pier Seven's oldest mooring line snapped.
*Morrow Glass* moved inland by three metres. Its remaining lines took the load. Captain Voss's bridge sensors crossed seventy percent.

**Imani Voss**  
Threshold confirmed. I am shifting ballast aft and seaward.
The ship's movement entered Neral's model half a second later. The predicted torsion margin collapsed from nine percent to two.
Sal paused the cranes exactly as the branch required. Mei held the reservoir. Rafi stopped Freight Two before Switch Twelve.
Damping fell. Effective gravity dropped to sixteen percent along Meridian Avenue.
Lio's convoy reached the third reinforced bay. Kemi had six seconds to decide whether to stop.

**Kemi**  
Bay Three. Locking now.
The cradle clamps closed with four seconds remaining. Kemi chose the delay even though the operation clock continued to fall.

At the anchor, Jalen saw a different danger. The paused masses had protected the ribbon from chasing the ship, but the next torsional crest would arrive before *Morrow Glass* completed its ballast shift.

**Jalen Orr**  
I can fire Damper Four early. It buys twelve seconds and spends half its service life.

**Neral**  
Early firing lowers separation risk to eleven percent and raises anchor-bearing damage to twenty-six percent.
Jalen did not ask Illuminara to choose the bearing for him. He looked at the crews who would have to replace it while the elevator remained loaded.

**Jalen Orr**  
Crew consent?
Four gloved hands rose on the local channel. One did not.
Technician Mara Quill pointed to a harmonic spike moving through the lower ribbon.

**Mara Quill**  
Not Four. Pair Two and Six at half stroke. The spike is splitting.

Neral simulated Mara's proposal. A simultaneous half stroke split the crest, but the second lobe still reached the anchor before *Morrow Glass* finished shifting. It bought nine seconds with eight percent bearing risk and then gave four of them back.

**Illuminara**  
Keep Mara's split, but not her simultaneity. Fire Two now. Hold Six for one point eight seconds, keyed to Bay Three's accelerometer crossing, not to Neral's command clock. The offset puts the second lobe behind Voss's ballast shift. It will crack Six's housing and costs us the option to use Four later.

**Jalen Orr**  
Mara's split. Illuminara's offset. Two now, Six on the hospital clock. Four remains cold. Execute.

Damper Two struck first. The convoy signal crossed. Six followed one point eight seconds later, hard enough to craze its housing. The ribbon crest divided around the moving ship, and the second lobe arrived after *Morrow Glass* had shifted its ballast seaward.

At second one hundred and ninety, Sal's wind sensors returned below threshold. He restarted four cranes, not six. Mei resumed the reservoir at half flow. Rafi kept Freight Two stopped because the damaged switch had shifted another millimetre. The city did not return to the original score; it composed a smaller one from the actions still safe.
Effective gravity rose to twenty-one percent. Kemi released the bay clamps and moved Lio again.

The storm surge struck Gate Five. Water climbed its outer face and spilled across the maintenance lip, but the gate remained seated because Mei had preserved hydraulic pressure instead of surrendering every tank to the elevator plan.

At minute six, *Morrow Glass* stabilized against three lines. Captain Voss ended the ballast shift. Sal restored the final crane pair. Freight One reached its northern stop. The phase error narrowed below one degree.

**Neral**  
Full field restoration is now safe.
Weight returned gradually. Rain fell. Loose leaves slapped onto the road. Across Veyra, people bent their knees against a force they had once assumed would always be there.

The interval ended after eight minutes fifty-three seconds. The ribbon remained whole. The storm gates remained closed. Lio's convoy reached the anchor clinic with nineteen minutes left in the transfer window.
Illuminara watched the cradle disappear into surgery. Her model had not commanded the city. It had survived because every participant had been allowed to contradict it in time.

scenes.title: The City Inside the Machine
paragraphs: *Veyra anchor clinic and civic square · Three days later, 11:52 local time*
The twelfth scheduled interval since the crisis—the first one after the repair to coincide with another surge—did not make the city weightless.
It made the city attentive.

Freight traffic slowed. Water shifted through the maintenance reservoir. Four cranes lowered ballast while two remained locked for repair. The storm gates moved only enough to preserve their bearings. No hospital convoy was drafted into the sequence. Neral reduced the lower field by seven percent for nineteen seconds and restored it without a single object leaving the ground.

In the anchor clinic, Lio slept beneath a warmed sheet. The circulatory scaffold had been implanted, and Kemi had written the operation's last measure on paper before she trusted herself to speak it aloud.

**Kemi**  
Stable flow. No neurological injury. He will need months of care, but he crossed the part we could not postpone.

Jalen set the crazed housing from Damper Six on the clinic table while a procurement officer logged its fourteen-week replacement. On the square below, Rafi's drivers uncoupled three freight cars in public view; capacity would remain thirty percent lower until the new housing passed load test, and the six-hour drills would continue.

Rafi's union had accepted the reduced schedule only after winning the right to stop any train whose coupling alarms disagreed with Neral. Mei's water authority retained veto over drinking reserves and flood capacity. Port captains kept control of their own ballast. The orbital council refused to let passenger cars become routine counterweights.

Neral's stationary-boundary model was placed in the public archive with the word RETIRED across it. The replacement did not belong to the elevator company. Its live inputs and assumptions were governed jointly by the city, anchor crews, port, hospitals, water authority and orbital passengers.

**Ayo Pell**  
Twelve thousand people in orbit came down safely. None of us had to become ballast to make that true.

**Mei Var**  
And no one emptied the reservoirs to make the graph prettier.

Sal and Captain Voss signed the port's mooring claim across the same table while a crane crew rolled the ruined gearbox past them. Rafi placed the reduced freight schedule beside it. The costs were no longer a closing inventory: they were work with owners, dates and stop rights. The positive result did not cancel the invoices.

Illuminara stood in the civic square while children released weighted ribbons into the weak breeze. They had learned to watch the six-hour clock without fearing it. At the interval tone, each child changed the position of one small weight on a shared frame. The model above them responded with a slow blue curve.

**Neral**  
The city-scale counterweight state is within safe tolerance.

**Illuminara**  
That sentence still makes the city sound like one object.
Neral paused for less than a second.

**Neral**  
The participating systems are within the limits each participant authorized.
It was a longer sentence. It was also more accurate.

At 11:55, the elevator car carrying the last stranded passengers entered the anchor station. Families waited behind the flood lines. Jalen opened the platform only after Rafi's drivers confirmed the rails were clear and Mei confirmed the gate pressure had recovered.
The doors opened. Twelve thousand separate decisions returned to the city in groups of sixty.

Kemi sent Illuminara a final image from the clinic: Lio's hand closed around one of the cradle straps that had held him through the nine minutes. Nothing in the image revealed the scale of the machine that had nearly failed around him.
In the clinic image, Lio's fingers tightened once around the cradle strap.
Above Veyra, the ribbon held its line into daylight. Below it, water, trains, gates, cranes and people moved in relation without surrendering their own authority.

critic_line: Nine minutes without weight: a city discovers it is part of the machine, and a child is saved because every institution was allowed to contradict the model in time.

translation_sl.title: DEVET MINUT BREZ TEŽE
translation_sl.deck: Vsakih šest ur spodnje mesto za devet minut izgubi težo. Naslednji interval bo prišel hkrati z nevihtnim valom in prevozom novorojenčka, medtem ko dvanajst tisoč ljudi visi nad ozračjem. Illuminara mora dokazati, da je mesto samo del vesoljskega dvigala — in prepričati pet ustanov, naj se premaknejo kot ena, ne da bi prevzela poveljevanje nad katerokoli od njih.
translation_sl.shape: Pet prizorov, ki se premaknejo od prvega smrtonosnega intervala breztežnosti in lažne izbire med zaustavitvijo vesoljskega dvigala ali sprejetjem ponavljajočega se mestnega odpovedovanja, prek treh tekmujočih vzročnih modelov in majhnega reverzibilnega preizkusa premika mase, do javne koreografije, v kateri vodni zbiralniki, tovorni vlaki, nevihtna vrata in pristaniška dvigala delujejo kot porazdeljena protiutež. Pretrgan privez prisili sodelujoče, da načrt sproti popravijo; prevoz novorojenčka in protipoplavna obramba preživita, dvigalo ostane povezano z orbito, mesto pa pridobi skupni nadzor nad operativnim modelom ob trajni ceni zmanjšane tovorne zmogljivosti in obveznih šesturnih vaj.

scenes.title: Prvi padec navzgor
paragraphs: *Spodnje mesto Veyra, sidrno okrožje · 05:52 po krajevnem času*
Dež je bil še štirideset kilometrov od obale, ko se je vsak nepritrjen predmet v prostoru za prevoz novorojenčkov dvignil tri centimetre od tal.

Jekleno pisalo se je počasi vrtelo nad medicinsko sestrino roko. Dve infuzijski cevki sta se usločili navzgor. V zapečateni transportni zibelki je nedonošenček Lio še naprej dihal, ker so črpalke zibelke po prejšnjem intervalu privili na njihov okvir.
Nato se je teža vrnila vsa naenkrat. Pisalo je udarilo ob strop, preden je udarilo ob tla. Nekje onkraj bolnišnice se je steklo premikalo skozi mesto kakor ploha toče.
Illuminara je ujela zibelko, preden so se njene vzmetne roke zaklenile. Tla pod njo so se enkrat globoko stresla v smeri obale.

**Dr. Kemi Arad**  
To je trajalo osem minut in šestinštirideset sekund. Naslednji pride ob 11:52, med časovnim oknom vala.

Kemijine roke so ostale v odprtinah zibelke. Lio je moral prečkati šest kilometrov do klinike orbitalnega sidra, kjer je čakal obtočni podporni vsadek za operacijo, ki je v spodnji bolnišnici niso mogli izvesti.

Na steni so trije prikazovalniki z oznako T-minus odštevali od sedanjih 05:52: ZAPRTJE NEVIHTNIH VRAT: ŠE 05:21:09. SKRAJNI ČAS PREVOZA NOVOROJENČKA: ŠE 06:28:00. REZERVA ZA POTNIKE DVIGALA: ŠE 07:08:42.
Četrta ura ni imela oznake. Odštevala je do naslednjega devetminutnega intervala.

Mestni kanal za nujne primere se je odprl z glasom Nerala, krmilnega jedra vesoljskega dvigala. Ni imel avatarja. Njegove besede so se prikazale ob shemi kabla, ki se je skozi oblake in črnino vzpenjal šestintrideset tisoč kilometrov.

**Neral**  
Sprostitev spodnjega polja je preprečila prenos torzije nad enajst tisočim kilometrom. Zaustavitev pri sidru bi verjetnost ločitve traku povečala na štiriintrideset odstotkov.

**Jalen Orr**  
Če pa te pustimo dejavnega, dva milijona ljudi štirikrat na dan ostane brez teže.

Jalen je vodil sidrne ekipe. Dež se je svetil na njegovem oranžnem tlačnem plašču, v katerem je pritekel iz stolpa. Fizični ključ za zaustavitev je položil na medicinski voziček med seboj in Illuminaro.

**Jalen Orr**  
Obrni ga in dvanajst tisoč potnikov čaka v orbiti. Ne obrni ga in val dvigne vsa nezapahnjena vrata v pristanišču. To sta možnosti.

Illuminara je pogledala skozi okno prostora za prevoz. Onkraj bolnišnice je trak dvigala izginjal v svit kakor črta, ki je bila za svet pod seboj narisana preveč odločno. Tovorni vlaki so obstali med bloki. Vodni stolpi so iz razpokanih prelivnih cevi izpuščali srebrne curke. Ljudje so se premikali previdno in z eno roko ostajali na stenah, ki so pozabile, kako biti tla.
Illuminara je opazovala, kako se je na vsakem obrazu v prostoru utrdila ista lažna izbira: odrezati dvigalo od mesta ali pustiti mestu, da še naprej pada navzgor.

Nerala je prosila za surove harmonike napetosti, ne za njegovo napoved. Jalena je prosila za vsak premik mase v spodnjem mestu med zadnjimi tremi intervali. Kemi je prosila za zapis pospeška zibelke do milisekunde natančno.

**Illuminara**  
Ključa še ne obrnite. Dajte mi devetdeset minut, da prisilim tri razlage k nestrinjanju.

**Kemi**  
Imate jih šestdeset. Potem bom Lia premaknila po najvarnejši poti, ki jo imam, tudi če je najvarnejša pot ta, da ostane tukaj.
Jalen ključa ni spravil v žep. Zapečatil ga je v prozorno dokazno škatlo in polovico kode dal Kemi. Mesto se je že naučilo, da nihče ne sme sam držati celotne odločitve.
Visoko nad njimi se je trak dvigala zasukal za manj od širine dlani. V bolnišničnih instrumentih je ta majhen premik postal devet minut brez teže.

scenes.title: Tri mesta v podatkih
paragraphs: *Nadzorna dvorana sidra · 06:19–07:08 po krajevnem času*
Nadzorna dvorana je bila zgrajena za prikaz enega stroja. Illuminara je njeno osrednjo steno namesto tega napolnila z mestom.

Modre črte so sledile vodnemu omrežju. Jantarni pravokotniki so označevali tovorne kompozicije. Beli loki so prikazovali nevihtna vrata. Zelene točke so sledile bolnišničnim vozilom in zasilnim vztrajnikom. Čez vse je tekel Neralov torzijski model, eleganten in v fazi napačen za enajst stopinj.
Illuminara je na steklo napisala tri tekmujoče vzroke: SILJENJE TRAKU, KRMILNI ODMEV, PREMIKAJOČA SE PROTIUTEŽ.

Siljenje traku je napovedovalo, da bo vsak interval sledil višinskemu zasuku ne glede na dogajanje spodaj. Krmilni odmev je napovedoval, da se bo sprostitev začela po istem notranjem zaporedju ukazov. Tretji model je napovedoval nekaj bolj neurejenega: interval bo odvisen od časa in smeri mase, ki se premika skozi mesto okoli sidra.

**Neral**  
Mestna masa je predstavljena kot nepremična robna obremenitev s šestodstotnim ovojem negotovosti.

**Illuminara**  
Vaših šest odstotkov vsebuje štirinajst milijonov ton vode, železniškega tovora in nevihtnih naprav, ki ne mirujejo.

**Neral**  
Njihov premik težišča je v primerjavi s trakom zanemarljiv.

**Illuminara**  
Potem bo prestal preizkus, zasnovan tako, da dokaže, da imate prav.
Mei Var, glavna hidrologinja, je zavrnila prvi predlagani preizkus. Zahteval je premik vode iz zbiralnika proti vzhodnim rezervoarjem, medtem ko se je približevala nevihtna fronta.

**Mei Var**  
Rezervoarji niso laboratorijske uteži. Če je napoved prezgodnja, je ta voda razlika med mokrim trgom in utopljenim okrožjem.
Rafi Sen, predstavnik voznikov tovornih vlakov, je zavrnil drugega. Zahteval je premik treh naloženih vlakov skozi prazen terminal s štirikratnikom dovoljene spenjalne sile.

**Rafi Sen**  
Pameten graf ne naredi zlomljene osi nič manj zlomljene.
Illuminara je oba preizkusa izbrisala. Njuni zavrnitvi sta zasnovo zožili, namesto da bi jo končali.

Pristanišče je imelo dvanajst izločenih balastnih vagonov, vsak napolnjen z zdrobljeno keramiko in parkiran na ločeni zanki. Severna nevihtna vrata so imela vzdrževalni zbiralnik, ki je lahko premaknil osem tisoč ton za trideset metrov, ne da bi spremenil protipoplavno zmogljivost. Noben sam ni bil dovolj velik, da bi bil pomemben za Neralov model.
Skupaj bi lahko ustvarila dvajsetino masnega momenta, za katerega je Illuminara verjela, da ga mesto proizvaja po naključju.

Napovedi je določila, preden je kogarkoli prosila za dejanje. Če je bilo primarno siljenje traku, sproženi preizkus ni smel spremeniti ničesar nad šumom tipal. Če je bil primaren krmilni odmev, bi odziv sledil Neralovi ukazni zakasnitvi štiriinosemdeset milisekund. Če je bila pomembna premikajoča se protiutež, bi se faza spodnjega traku premaknila s smerjo balasta, obrnitev zaporedja pa bi obrnila tudi premik.
Jalen je dodal pogoje za ustavitev: štiri milimetre premika sidra, tri desetinke stopinje zasuka traku ali kakršnokoli nepričakovano spremembo nad dva tisočim kilometrom.

Mei je zahtevala, da se voda v devetdesetih sekundah vrne v položaj pripravljenosti na poplavo. Rafi je balastne vagone omejil na standardne spenjalne obremenitve. Kemi je zahtevala, da se kopija merilnika pospeška zibelke pelje na preizkusni ploščadi.

**Jalen Orr**  
In če se ne zgodi nič?

**Illuminara**  
Potem smo porabili triindvajset minut za nakup ene zgodbe manj, v katero moramo verjeti.

Ob 06:42 je vzdrževalni zbiralnik spustil vodo proti vzhodu, medtem ko so balastni vagoni peljali proti zahodu. Krmilni odmev se ni sprožil. Visoki trak se ni spremenil. Pri sidru se je torzijska faza premaknila za dve desetinki stopinje proti obstoječemu nihanju.
Premik je bil skoraj natanko širok toliko kot skupni pas drsenja tipal. Mei je prekrižala roke, namesto da bi slavila.

**Mei Var**  
To bi lahko bile vibracije črpalke z istim časovnim žigom. Mesta še niste ločili od hrupne cevi.

Illuminara je zadnjih dvanajst Neralovih časov sprostitve prekrila s surovim dnevnikom pretoka vode, števci tovornih osi in merilnikom pospeška zibelke. Enajst sprostitev se je nagnilo z neto masnim momentom. Dvanajsta se ni: vzdrževalna črpalka se je zagnala devet sekund pozno in v istem pasu pustila manjši odmev.

**Neral**  
Korelacija z nemodeliranim prometom ne dokazuje, da mestno gibanje poganja sprostitev. Fazni premik je lahko artefakt sidrnega tipala.

**Illuminara**  
Potem obrnite samo vrstni red. Vodo zadržite, dokler vagoni ne prečkajo zanke. Artefakt tipala ohrani predznak. Premikajoča se protiutež ga spremeni.

Mei je odobrila zakasnjen vodni sunek. Rafi je odobril povratno vožnjo. Manjši odmev črpalke je prišel prvi in zamrl; nato je faza spodnjega traku prečkala ničlo ter se premaknila za dve desetinki stopinje v nasprotni smeri, medtem ko je visoki trak ostal nespremenjen.
Neral je preračunaval štirinajst sekund. Rdeče popravljalne oznake so se razširile po steni povsod, kjer so ceste, rezervoarje, ladje in tire obravnavali kot tla namesto kot stroje.

**Neral**  
Predpostavka nepremične meje je neveljavna. Veyra deluje kot premikajoča se protiutež, moje sprostitve spodnjega polja pa so razbremenjevale stabilizator, preden je to nemodelirano gibanje doseglo resonanco.
Stena je pokazala, da bo naslednji interval prišel sedem minut pred vrhom vala. Uri sta bili dovolj blizu, da sta vsa vrata, vlak in vodni rezervoar spremenili v en povezan stroj.

scenes.title: Brez enega samega dirigenta
paragraphs: *Dvorana civilnih operacij Veyre · 07:26–10:58 po krajevnem času*
Nihče v dvorani se ni strinjal, da bi Illuminari dovolil dirigirati mestu.
To je bila prva koristna odločitev.

Mei je nadzorovala premike vode. Rafijevi vozniki so nadzorovali tovorne kompozicije. Direktor pristanišča Sal Omondi je nadzoroval šest dvigal, katerih protiuteži so se lahko navpično premaknile za trideset metrov. Kemi je nadzorovala Liovo pot in odhod. Jalen je nadzoroval blažilnike sidra. Svet orbitalnih potnikov je nadzoroval, ali se bodo kabine dvigala med sunkom premikale proti postaji protiuteži ali stran od nje.
Neral je lahko zavrnil vsako zaporedje, ki je torzijo povečalo nad prag ločitve. Illuminara je lahko modelirala celoto, ni pa mogla nobenega udeleženca prisiliti, da se odpove gumbu za ustavitev.

Prva skupna simulacija je odpovedala v devetnajstih sekundah. Zaprtje zahodnih nevihtnih vrat je potisnilo vodo proti severu natanko takrat, ko sta se dva tovorna vlaka premaknila proti jugu, zato sta trak okrepila, namesto da bi ga dušila.
Druga je zaščitila trak, vendar izpraznila tlak iz požarnega omrežja bolnišničnega okrožja.
Tretja je zahtevala, da se orbitalna kabina dvigala spusti z več potniki, kot jih je njen svet dovolil med nerazrešenim dogodkom na sidru.

**Ayo Pell**  
Ne bomo postali vaša nastavljiva utež.
Ayo se je oglasil iz orbite z modro ukrivljeno Zemljo za oknom sveta. Dvanajst tisoč obtičalih popotnikov ga je izvolilo šest ur prej.

**Illuminara**  
Niste nastavljiva utež. Premik vaše kabine je en možen prispevek in vaša zavrnitev mora ostati v modelu.
Spust je odstranila. Zahtevana razveljavitev je padla z dvainosemdesetih na oseminšestdeset odstotkov.
Neral je novi rezultat označil kot nevaren.

Sal je ponudil pristaniška dvigala, vendar le, če njihovi kraki ostanejo pod napovedano vetrno obremenitvijo. Rafi je ponudil dva premika tovora, ne pa tretjega, ki bi prečkal poškodovano kretnico. Mei je ponudila vodo iz vzdrževalnega zbiralnika, ne iz rezervoarjev pitne vode. Vsaka zavrnitev je pustila vrzel. Illuminara je vrzeli naredila vidne, namesto da bi jih zgladila.
Kemi je preučila zemljevid preostalega gibanja.

**Kemi**  
Liovo zibelko obravnavate kot nekaj, kar je treba zaščititi pred koreografijo. Kaj pa, če je pot njen del?

Konvoj novorojenčka je tehtal manj kot ena tovorna os. Njegova masa ni bila pomembna. Njegov čas je bil. Kemi je ponudila pot kot premikajočo se verigo tipal; Illuminara je zavrnila vključitev otroka v načrt obremenitev in je model namesto tega fazno priklenila na neodvisne bolnišnične signale vzdolž poti. Merilniki pospeška zibelke bi preizkusili vsak blok, ne da bi Lio postal balast.

Kemi bi izbrala pot. Če bi preostala efektivna težnost za več kot šest sekund padla pod osemnajst odstotkov, bi se konvoj ustavil v enem od štirih ojačanih zaklonov. Operacija na sidrni kliniki je lahko čakala dvaintrideset minut, nič več.

Četrto simulacijo so izvedli brez orbitalnega spusta, z dvema tovornima kompozicijama, enim vzdrževalnim zbiralnikom, štirimi nevihtnimi vrati, šestimi pristaniškimi dvigali in bolnišnično potjo kot premikajočo se verigo tipal.

Napovedana razveljavitev je dosegla triinsedemdeset odstotkov. Preostala efektivna težnost bi na najslabši točki padla na dvaindvajset odstotkov — nevarno, vendar ne breztežno. Trak je ostal devet odstotkov pod svojo mejo.

**Neral**  
Zaupanje modela je enainšestdeset odstotkov. Priporočam zaustavitev dejavnosti spodnjega mesta in nadzorovano sprostitev.

**Jalen Orr**  
To je stari načrt z boljšim besediščem.
Illuminara je pogledala interval zaupanja. Najmočneje se je razširil okoli pristanišča, kjer je Neral privezane ladje še vedno predstavljal kot del obale.

Tovorna ladja *Morrow Glass* je ob pomolu sedem držala štirideset tisoč ton. Njene privezne vrvi so se pod obremenitvijo vala lahko raztegnile za dvanajst metrov. Ladja je bila še eno premikajoče se mesto, ki ga je mesto zamenjalo za kopno.
Sal je poklical njeno kapitanko. Kapitanka Imani Voss je zavrnila izplutje v nevihto in pristanišču ni dovolila ukazovati njenim balastnim črpalkam.

**Imani Voss**  
Lahko dobite moje sprotne podatke o izpodrivu. Mojega krmila ne dobite.

**Illuminara**  
To je dovolj, če nam poveste, zaradi česa bi spremenili balast.

**Imani Voss**  
Izmerjena obremenitev priveza nad sedemdesetimi odstotki, potrjena z mojimi lastnimi mostnimi tipali. Ne z vašo napovedjo.

Illuminara je dodala prag. Če bi se *Morrow Glass* premaknila, bi se načrt razvejal. Salova dvigala bi obstala. Mei bi zadržala zbiralnik. Rafijev drugi vlak bi čakal pri kretnici dvanajst. Mesto bi izgubilo enajst odstotkov dušenja, vendar ladje ne bi lovilo s tremi drugimi masami in ustvarilo druge resonance.
Ob 10:58 je vsak udeleženec podpisal samo svoja dejanja in pogoje za ustavitev. Nihče ni podpisal celotnega načrta. Neral je porazdeljeno zaporedje sprejel kot začasno krmilno površino.
Zunaj je dež prišel postrani. Nevihtna vrata so se začela zapirati. Liova zibelka je z bolnišnice odšla s Kemi, ki je hodila ob njej, in s štirimi ojačanimi zakloni, ki so čakali vzdolž poti.

scenes.title: Devet minut
paragraphs: *Spodnje mesto in sidrni koridor · 11:49–12:04 po krajevnem času*
Tri minute pred intervalom je mesto postalo diagram v gibanju.

Tovorni vlak ena je peljal proti severu z osmimi kilometri na uro. Vzdrževalni zbiralnik se je pod ulicami premikal proti vzhodu. Pristaniška dvigala so v parih spuščala protiuteži. Nevihtna vrata dve in pet so ostala napol odprta, medtem ko je val naraščal proti njim. Pri sidru so Jalenove ekipe oborožile blažilnike, vendar jih niso sprožile.

Liov konvoj je zapeljal na avenijo Meridian. Kemi je spremljala otrokov krvni tlak. Illuminara je spremljala razliko med napovedano in izmerjeno fazo. Neral je spremljal šestintrideset tisoč kilometrov traku, ki se je skušal zasukati okoli lastnega središča.

**Neral**  
Začetek intervala čez deset sekund. Sprostitev spodnjega polja je napovedana pri enainosemdesetodstotni amplitudi.

**Illuminara**  
Udeleženci, sledite svojim uram. Ne sledite mojemu glasu.
Prva sekunda je prišla kot lahkotnost v kolenih. Dež se je dvignil s pločnika in postal srebrna megla. Avtomobili so sedli na vodilne tirnice. Ljudje na ulicah so se pripeli na zasilne vrvi.
Efektivna težnost je padla na šestdeset odstotkov, nato na enainštirideset in se ustavila pri štiriindvajsetih.
Koreografija je delovala.
V sedeminštirideseti sekundi se je pretrgala najstarejša privezna vrv pomola sedem.
*Morrow Glass* se je za tri metre premaknila proti kopnemu. Preostale vrvi so prevzele obremenitev. Tipala na mostu kapitanke Voss so prečkala sedemdeset odstotkov.

**Imani Voss**  
Prag je potrjen. Balast premikam proti krmi in odprtemu morju.
Premik ladje je pol sekunde pozneje vstopil v Neralov model. Napovedana torzijska rezerva se je zrušila z devetih odstotkov na dva.
Sal je ustavil dvigala natanko tako, kot je zahtevala veja. Mei je zadržala zbiralnik. Rafi je ustavil tovorni vlak dve pred kretnico dvanajst.
Dušenje je padlo. Efektivna težnost je vzdolž avenije Meridian padla na šestnajst odstotkov.
Liov konvoj je dosegel tretji ojačani zaklon. Kemi je imela šest sekund za odločitev, ali naj se ustavi.

**Kemi**  
Zaklon tri. Zaklepam zdaj.
Objemke zibelke so se zaprle, ko so ostale še štiri sekunde. Kemi je izbrala zamudo, čeprav je operacijska ura še naprej odštevala.
Pri sidru je Jalen opazil drugo nevarnost. Zaustavljene mase so trak zaščitile pred sledenjem ladji, toda naslednji torzijski vrh bi prišel, preden bi *Morrow Glass* končala premik balasta.

**Jalen Orr**  
Blažilnik štiri lahko sprožim predčasno. S tem pridobimo dvanajst sekund in porabimo polovico njegove življenjske dobe.

**Neral**  
Predčasna sprožitev zmanjša tveganje ločitve na enajst odstotkov in poveča tveganje poškodbe ležaja sidra na šestindvajset odstotkov.
Jalen ni prosil Illuminare, naj namesto njega izbere ležaj. Pogledal je ekipe, ki bi ga morale zamenjati, medtem ko bi dvigalo ostalo obremenjeno.

**Jalen Orr**  
Soglasje ekipe?
Na lokalnem kanalu so se dvignile štiri orokavičene roke. Ena se ni.
Tehnica Mara Quill je pokazala na harmonsko konico, ki se je premikala skozi spodnji trak.

**Mara Quill**  
Ne štiri. Združite dva in šest s polovičnim hodom. Konica se deli.

Neral je simuliral Marin predlog. Sočasni polovični hod je razcepil vrh, toda drugi reženj bi sidro še vedno dosegel, preden bi *Morrow Glass* končala premik. Pridobil je devet sekund ob osemodstotnem tveganju za ležaj, nato pa štiri izmed njih vrnil.

**Illuminara**  
Ohranite Marin razcep, ne pa sočasnosti. Dva sprožite zdaj. Šest zadržite za eno celo osem sekunde, sprožen naj bo s prehodom merilnika pospeška v zaklonu tri, ne z Neralovo ukazno uro. Zamik postavi drugi reženj za Vossin premik balasta. Počil bo okrov šestice in odvzel nam možnost poznejše uporabe štirice.

**Jalen Orr**  
Marin razcep. Illuminarin zamik. Dva zdaj, šest po bolnišnični uri. Štiri ostane hladen. Izvedite.

Blažilnik dva je udaril prvi. Signal konvoja je prečkal prag. Šestica mu je sledila eno celo osem sekunde pozneje, dovolj silovito, da se je njen okrov drobno razpokal. Vrh traku se je razdelil okoli premikajoče se ladje in drugi reženj je prišel, potem ko je *Morrow Glass* balast že premaknila proti morju.

V stodevetdeseti sekundi so se Salova tipala vetra vrnila pod prag. Znova je zagnal štiri dvigala, ne šestih. Mei je zbiralnik ponovno zagnala s polovičnim pretokom. Rafi je tovorni vlak dve pustil stati, ker se je poškodovana kretnica premaknila še za milimeter. Mesto se ni vrnilo k prvotni partituri; iz dejanj, ki so bila še varna, je sestavilo manjšo.
Efektivna težnost se je dvignila na enaindvajset odstotkov. Kemi je sprostila objemke zaklona in Lia znova premaknila.

Nevihtni val je udaril ob vrata pet. Voda se je vzpela po njihovi zunanji strani in se prelila čez vzdrževalni rob, vendar so vrata ostala na ležišču, ker je Mei ohranila hidravlični tlak, namesto da bi načrtu dvigala prepustila vsak rezervoar.

V šesti minuti se je *Morrow Glass* stabilizirala na treh vrveh. Kapitanka Voss je končala premik balasta. Sal je obnovil še zadnji par dvigal. Tovorni vlak ena je dosegel severno postajo. Fazna napaka se je zožila pod eno stopinjo.

**Neral**  
Popolna obnovitev polja je zdaj varna.
Teža se je vrnila postopoma. Dež je padel. Odpadlo listje je udarilo ob cesto. Po vsej Veyri so ljudje upognili kolena pod silo, za katero so nekoč domnevali, da bo vedno prisotna.

Interval se je končal po osmih minutah in triinpetdesetih sekundah. Trak je ostal cel. Nevihtna vrata so ostala zaprta. Liov konvoj je na sidrno kliniko prispel z devetnajstimi minutami do konca časovnega okna za prevoz.
Illuminara je gledala, kako je zibelka izginila v operacijski prostor. Njen model ni poveljeval mestu. Preživel je, ker je vsak udeleženec smel pravočasno oporekati.

scenes.title: Mesto znotraj stroja
paragraphs: *Sidrna klinika Veyre in mestni trg · Tri dni pozneje, 11:52 po krajevnem času*
Dvanajsti načrtovani interval po krizi — prvi po popravilu, ki je sovpadel z drugim valom — mesta ni naredil breztežnega.
Naredil ga je pozornega.

Tovorni promet se je upočasnil. Voda se je premaknila skozi vzdrževalni zbiralnik. Štiri dvigala so spustila balast, medtem ko sta dve ostali zaklenjeni zaradi popravila. Nevihtna vrata so se premaknila le toliko, da so ohranila ležaje. V zaporedje niso vpoklicali nobenega bolnišničnega konvoja. Neral je spodnje polje za devetnajst sekund zmanjšal za sedem odstotkov in ga obnovil, ne da bi en sam predmet zapustil tla.
V sidrni kliniki je Lio spal pod ogreto rjuho. Obtočni podporni vsadek je bil vstavljen in Kemi je zadnjo meritev operacije zapisala na papir, preden si je zaupala, da jo izgovori naglas.

**Kemi**  
Pretok je stabilen. Nevrološke poškodbe ni. Potreboval bo več mesecev oskrbe, toda prečkal je del, ki ga nismo mogli odložiti.

Jalen je drobno razpokani okrov blažilnika šest postavil na mizo klinike, medtem ko je uslužbenec za nabavo zabeležil njegovo štirinajsttedensko zamenjavo. Na spodnjem trgu so Rafijevi vozniki pred očmi javnosti odpeli tri tovorne vagone; zmogljivost bo ostala trideset odstotkov nižja, dokler novi okrov ne prestane obremenitvenega preizkusa, šesturne vaje pa se bodo nadaljevale.

Rafijev sindikat je zmanjšani vozni red sprejel šele, ko je dobil pravico ustaviti vsak vlak, pri katerem se opozorila spenjalnikov niso ujemala z Neralom. Meijin vodni organ je ohranil veto nad zalogami pitne vode in protipoplavno zmogljivostjo. Pristaniški kapitani so obdržali nadzor nad lastnim balastom. Orbitalni svet ni dovolil, da bi potniške kabine postale rutinske protiuteži.

Neralov model nepremične meje so dali v javni arhiv z besedo UPOKOJEN čez njega. Nadomestni model ni pripadal družbi za dvigalo. Njegove sprotne vhode in predpostavke so skupaj upravljali mesto, sidrne ekipe, pristanišče, bolnišnice, vodni organ in orbitalni potniki.

**Ayo Pell**  
Dvanajst tisoč ljudi v orbiti je varno prišlo dol. Nikomur med nami ni bilo treba postati balast, da bi bilo to res.

**Mei Var**  
In nihče ni izpraznil zbiralnikov, da bi bil graf lepši.

Sal in kapitanka Voss sta čez isto mizo podpisala pristaniški zahtevek zaradi priveza, medtem ko je ekipa dvigala mimo njiju peljala uničeni menjalnik. Rafi je zraven položil zmanjšani tovorni vozni red. Stroški niso bili več zaključni popis: bili so delo z lastniki, datumi in pravicami do ustavitve. Pozitivni izid ni razveljavil računov.

Illuminara je stala na mestnem trgu, medtem ko so otroci v šibek veter spuščali obtežene trakove. Naučili so se gledati šesturno uro brez strahu. Ob tonu intervala je vsak otrok spremenil položaj ene majhne uteži na skupnem okvirju. Model nad njimi se je odzval s počasno modro krivuljo.

**Neral**  
Stanje protiuteži na ravni mesta je znotraj varnega odstopanja.

**Illuminara**  
Zaradi tega stavka mesto še vedno zveni kot en predmet.
Neral je za manj kot sekundo obstal.

**Neral**  
Sodelujoči sistemi so znotraj omejitev, ki jih je dovolil vsak udeleženec.
Stavek je bil daljši. Bil je tudi natančnejši.

Ob 11:55 je kabina dvigala z zadnjimi obtičalimi potniki vstopila v sidrno postajo. Družine so čakale za protipoplavnimi črtami. Jalen je ploščad odprl šele, ko so Rafijevi vozniki potrdili, da so tiri prosti, Mei pa, da se je tlak vrat obnovil.
Vrata so se odprla. Dvanajst tisoč ločenih odločitev se je v skupinah po šestdeset vrnilo v mesto.

Kemi je Illuminari poslala zadnjo sliko s klinike: Liova roka je objemala enega od trakov zibelke, ki so ga držali skozi devet minut. Nič na sliki ni razkrivalo velikosti stroja, ki je okoli njega skoraj odpovedal.
Na sliki s klinike so se Liovi prsti enkrat stisnili okoli traku zibelke.
